name: pn532
title: NXP PN532

facts.source: UM0701-02 PN532 User Manual, InListPassiveTarget: 2 targets at most; NXP PN532_C1.pdf Rev. 3.6: 13.56 MHz, ITVDD 150 mA at most at VBAT 5 V, total supply below 100 mA with the recommended antenna tuning and 150 mA at most at VBAT 3.4 V, soft power down 45 uA at most

firmware.notes: pn532_get_firmware_version gave 0x32010607 on both modules of the terminal

notes: A Jewel card is one target only.
The range is that of the antenna: see the modules.
tx_mw_max is the supply of the transmitter, 5 V at 150 mA. The datasheet gives no radiated power.
